description: Find makeup looks shown in BeautySpark articles, filtered by color season, article type and words. With a season, looks made for that season come first; general looks (no season) follow and are labelled. Returns look ids for get_article_look and the article URL to cite.

locale.description: The user's language as a language tag, e.g. "de" or "pt-BR". Set it from the user's language. Defaults to English.

query.description: Words to match against the look title, tags and image description, e.g. "smoky", "graphic liner".

season.description: Color season, e.g. "True Winter" or "true_winter". One of the 12 seasons.

name: find_article_looks
title: Find article looks
